text:
noah: FYI I'm locking runtime v3.3 for ML-embed canary after seeing sporadic rerank regressions. Suspect mismatch with sdk-client 3.0 on packed-kv headers.

deply-bot: created pin 'pin-295555' scope=runtime:v3.3;route:ml-embed;region:eu-canary. Reason: rerank drift with sdk 3.0.

ivy: can you paste a short failing trace or repro? I can spin a canary node for focused tests.

noah: repro summary: p95 similarity drop ~6% for long inputs (>2k tokens). Trace: KVHeaderParseError in kv_parser.cpp. Runs reproduced on eu-canary-01.

sre-bot: recommended mitigation: route long-embed requests to runtime:v3.2 for canary; add console banner; schedule 4h soak.

deply-bot: suggested command: `/deploy route-update --route canary-eu-embed --match "len>2048" --fallback runtime:v3.2` (dry-run available).

ivy: I'll run repro with sdk 2.9 and 3.0 to isolate. If SDK is culprit, prefer an SDK shim; if runtime kernel changed, patch runtime and test v3.3.1-canary.

noah: agree. Owners: @noah,@ivy. Do not release pin until we have parity tests passing and a 4h stable window.

deply-bot: pin 'pin-295555' active at 2955550360. Manual release required.
